page.overview:
Who is Arthoni?

Arthoni was a fictional princess-warrior who featured in the play Amon Daak, written by Moobian Tax. While impersonating Imperial Moff Tan Hubi, the Clawdite Tunga Arpagion performed the play with C-3PO, taking the role of Arthoni.
